Actions.Text: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG ABUSE

Title: Requires government entities review and post information about funds received pursuant to the statewide opioid settlement agreement
Summary: Requires government entities review and post information about funds received pursuant to the statewide opioid settlement agreement including information about how such funds are being used properly.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to the review and approval of information concerning the statewide opioid settlement agreement
